correctness.rationale: Each enabled ordered recoloring strictly increases the integer agreement score (at most 15), so trajectories reach an absorbing coloring and exact rational backward recurrence is a terminating proof. Two separately written scripts using distinct Petersen graph constructions exhaust all 59049 states, independently agree on the 579 terminal counts, four full uniform-initial absorption fractions, and all 360 geometric 7:2:1 placements. Rates per allowed recoloring and tie rejection are explicitly normalized.

originality.rationale: The exact 579-state classification, four uniform-initial absorption fractions, and sharp tricolor 7:2:1 nucleation law are absent from examined primary statements. One-dimensional q-Potts persistence and general metastability do not imply a strict zero-energy-tie-rejecting Petersen chain; existing Petersen binary dynamics cannot encode tricolor configurations. Searches do not establish absolute uniqueness.

value.rationale: The complete q=3 dynamic trapping law on the canonical cubic girth-five cage is a natural exact finite-size statistical-physics benchmark. The sharp five-class geometric support for three minority seeds and the rare 11/270 nucleation probability reveal a concrete color-assist mechanism not inferred from static Potts ground states or the prior binary-spin study. The finite nature is stated without an ungrounded large-network generalization.
